about: Verdict per state text, judged against what the machine still owes in that state (check/state_list.py prints the owed stages). right: the role and the owed steps match the state. half right: they match, but the text adds a claim the machine does not support. wrong: the text describes another state or the wrong duties. Every text not listed here is right. The new texts and the wrong stored texts are the fix worker's read (Opus, 2026-11-21, tp-descriptions); the two half-right stored texts of tpl-precedence-1-goal (u5, u6) were added when this entry re-read the stored texts.

u4: Holds u5's text: the door was shut with the key in hand and the box is still to get, so it reads as pending. u4 is the final state.
u5: Holds u6's text: the box is picked up and only the door is left. In u5 the box is not picked up yet.
u6: Holds u4's text: it claims successful completion. u6 is not final; the door must still be opened.

u1: Holds u6's content: it says the ball has been moved. In u1 only the box has been picked up; the ball, the key and the door are all still owed.
u5: The owed steps are right, but it says that dropping the ball back before taking the key breaks the order. Once the ball has moved the order holds: only u0, u1, u3 and u4 have edges into the failure state u2, and none of them is reachable from u5.
u6: The owed steps are right, but it says that dropping the ball back before taking the key breaks the order. Once the ball has moved the order holds: only u0, u1, u3 and u4 have edges into the failure state u2, and none of them is reachable from u6.
u8: Says every requirement is met and the task is complete. u8 is not final: the door has not been opened.
u10: Says every requirement is met and the task is complete. u10 is not final: the key has never been taken.

u1: Role and owed steps are right, but it adds that the run cannot finish because picking up the box ends the episode. That is a claim about the level; the machine can still finish from u1.
u10: Role and owed step are right, but it adds that the key can no longer be taken because picking up the box ends the episode. That is a claim about the level; the machine can still finish from u10.

u3: Says an order was taken and still needs preparing and serving. In u3 only the pickup of the fallen food is owed.
u8: Says the client's order is already taken. In u8 the order is still to be taken, and the fallen food picked up.
u10: Says food is prepared and waiting to be served. In u10 the earlier order still needs its food prepared, and the new client's order taken.
u12: Names only the serve. u12 owes both preparing food for a taken order and serving the prepared food.
u13: Says no order is taken and names only the serve and the pickup. u13 also owes preparing food for a taken order.
u15: Names the new order and the serve, not the preparing. u15 owes taking an order, preparing food and serving.
u16: Names the new order, the serve and the pickup, not the preparing. u16 owes all four.
